property_summary: For any call to sendMoney, the reference contract's call either succeeds or the entire transaction reverts, keeping depositsCount unchanged; the mutant always reverts after executing the external call, so depositsCount can be incremented via fallback yet sendMoney still reverts, differing in revert behavior observable via a try/catch flag.
change_summary: Replace the require that checks call success with a revert, changing the failure behavior.
